name: Daily Habit Tracker

listing.title: Daily Habit Tracker - 7-Day Printable Habit Grid
listing.description:
A printable habit planner featuring a 7-day habit grid with tick boxes for daily routine tracking.

Inside: a cover, a How to use page, the Daily Habit Tracker page, and the Weekly Habit Review page.

Print on A4 or US Letter paper, as often as you need, for personal use.
listing.buyer: adults who want a simple printable 7-day habit tracker

instructions: Print the A4 or US Letter file at 100% scale.
Write your recurring habits in the first column.
Tick the box corresponding to each day of the week as you complete your habit.
cover_image_idea: The Daily Habit Tracker page printed on clean paper.
